answer: To mitigate Sybil proliferation, we propose a mechanism where agents commit capital to dynamic opportunity-cost bonds, tethered to a subgame-perfect slashing matrix that captures the pulse of network stake distribution. As the dawn of a malicious identity expansion occurs, capital barriers force an expected payoff nadir, rendering additive identities strictly irrational. Thus, the system converges to a unique Nash equilibrium where honest participation remains the dominant strategy.
